description: Credits (business template), the administration side: action "balance" { owner, kind? } or "adjust" { owner, kind?, delta } (a refund by hand, a gift; never below 0). Credit kinds and the products that top them up: neblla_update_app({ business: { credits: { <kind>: { products: { <productId>: n } } } } }).

env.description: "pro" (the published app, default) or "pre" (its draft: pre's services and config, on pre's data, its own unless it plays with pro's). Try the business in pre before publishing it. The pre id (_<id>) as appId is the same as env "pre"

owner.description: The user id in the app

name: neblla_credits
